author: TheMasterCow
body:
You spawn with all gold armor, a stone pickaxe, and an iron sword; you have to rush to the center to control the gold. While you control it, there are 2 aspects: Miners and Claimers. Claimers stand on a point to claim the mine, while miners have to break the most gold ore blocks on each team to win. Whoever mines the most gold ore gets a set amount of points, along with including the factor of who claimed the control point most of the game.

Maps will be a general cave layout, with side-points that are worth less than the center. When a certain amount of gold blocks are broken, a "drop" will occur. Golden apples and golden pickaxes will be handed out for 5 seconds and you can use those to your advantage.

After the points are claimed, wool dungeons unlock in "Wool Mode". You have to grab wools and bring them back to your base. Each wool is worth 10 points. After capturing 7 wools, you move on to the final mode; TDM. You are teleported out into a battlefield in the cave where you're frozen for 10 seconds and given a diamond sword to replace your iron one. Each kill is worth 2 points. After you die 3 times, you are eliminated and turned into a spectator. The last man standing will earn their team 100 (or more) points. Then, once calculated, the match will give the winning team XP to spend in a shop where you can buy upgrades in other matches around the gamemode such as water breathing and night vision.

What makes this gamemode unique is basically the maps. Each one should be very unique and differing from another.

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body:
Wow. So...Prison meets CTW meets TDM? Like it. 

Maybe instead of having a wools dungeon, have a sheep spawner and pen. You would have to kill a sheep (your team color) and bring the wool back. The other team would not be able to Pick up your wools. I just think sheep would be a cool aspect of the game.
